summary: The customer called to report a sudden internet outage. The agent checked the system, identified a general area outage due to a main cable cut, and informed the customer that technicians are working on it with an estimated restoration time of two to three hours. The agent also offered 5GB of free data as compensation for the downtime, concluding the call politely.

evidence.text: السيستم رح يضيف لك 5GB مجاناً على خطك كاعتذار منا.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Add 5GB of free data to the customer's line once the internet is restored.

evidence.text: مرحبا معك شركة الاتصالات، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, professional, and maintained a respectful tone throughout the call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك، خليني أشيك على السيستم فوراً.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with reassuring phrases and empathy.

evidence.text: المتوقع يرجع خلال ساعتين لثلاث ساعات بالكثير.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the root cause, provided an ETA, and offered compensation.
